items.title: VP ≠ VNP over Every Field
items.title_zh: Anthropic 论文宣称在任意域上 VP ≠ VNP
items.title_en: Anthropic Paper Claims VP ≠ VNP Over Every Field
items.summary: Anthropic's formal-math repository presents a paper claiming VP ≠ VNP over every field, sparking intense discussion about complexity theory and AI-assisted mathematical discovery.

items.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.title_zh: 英伟达董事会重新任命黄仁勋为CEO，称曾听取美国政府意见
items.title_en: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO After US Government Input
items.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director after reportedly receiving input from senior US government officials, sparking large-scale debate on board liability, national security, and the inconsistency of US semiconductor export policy.

items.title: Ladybird is now in alpha
items.title_zh: 从零自研的独立浏览器引擎 Ladybird 进入 Alpha 阶段
items.title_en: Ladybird, the from-scratch independent browser engine, reaches alpha
items.summary: The Ladybird browser, built from scratch as an independent engine, has entered alpha and is already rendering most tested sites correctly, prompting an enthusiastic and technically detailed HN discussion.

items.title: GLM-5.4: Toward generalized coding with our first loop transformer
items.title_zh: 智谱发布GLM-5.4：首个循环Transformer模型，主打泛化编程
items.title_en: Zhipu AI releases GLM-5.4, its first looped-transformer model, targeting generalized coding
items.summary: Zhipu AI releases GLM-5.4, its first looped-transformer model aimed at generalized coding, drawing strong HN interest for its transparent technical details and architectural novelty.

items.title: Codex2api 疑似遭供应链投毒
items.title_zh: Codex2api 疑似因作者账号被黑遭供应链投毒
items.title_en: Codex2api Hit by Suspected Supply-Chain Poisoning After Author Account Compromise
items.summary: Codex2api's author account was reportedly compromised, allowing malicious release tags with a backdoor that removed authentication and exfiltrated GitHub Actions secrets, requiring immediate downgrade and credential rotation.

items.title: Meta AI 负责人称超级智能将至，控制权堪忧
items.title_zh: Meta AI 负责人 Alexandr Wang 称超级智能即将到来，人类恐难掌控
items.title_en: Meta AI chief Alexandr Wang says superintelligence is near and control is at risk
items.summary: Meta AI chief Alexandr Wang warns that superintelligence is arriving and hard to control, citing a claimed Claude-assisted formal proof of the Riemann Hypothesis as evidence of rapid progress.
